text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Egyptian cabinet will discuss economic reports on Sunday dealing with the tourism and economic development of north Suez to make it fit for investors and a hub for economic and financial activity. They will discuss making the region a free trade zone in the manner of Hong Kong and Dubai.

- President Hosni Mubarak will make a trip to Toshka this week to oversee the start of projects, including an agricultural project on 50,000 feddans for raw cotton to be manufactured into textiles. Abu Dhabi Crown Prince Sheikh Khalifa bin Zaid al-Nahayan of the United Arab Emirates is to discuss with Mubarak setting up an agricultural company in Toshka.
The UAE is setting up a holding company for investment in Egypt with a capital of 300 million pounds.
- Mubarak congratulates Tony Blair, the new prime minister of the United Kingdom, and says he hopes Blair will strengthen the contribution of his country to the cause of peace.
- Foreign Minister Amr Moussa says Egypt and Kenya have signed agreements to increase economic ties.
